text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Hurry, hurry! Let's go to that 
trendy cafe and get some grown-up coffee 
jelly!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"No, a toy store, a toy store! Everyone 
will definitely love cool Carrotman 
vehicles and stuff like that!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, you two are such babies. Why 
don't you take some interest in black 
magic? Like me!"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Aaaalright, calm down, everyone~. I'll be 
sure to visit all of you later, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure not to run, okay~? Even 
when an Umamusume just jogs, she's still 
pretty fast.
choice_data_list: There are a lot of people here, too.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm so sooorry...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm soooo sorry...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're so good for reflecting on 
what you did~♪ Good boy, good boy~♪ *pat 
pat pat*~♪

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Aaah♪

Today, I was out shopping together with 
the four of them.

Having bumped into each other at the 
academy and realizing they all had the 
same destination, they decided to hang out 
together.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Let's go to the toy store 
first! You understand how cool Sentai 
heroes are, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, no~! Café comes first~! You know what 
grown-up charm is all about, right! Coffee 
jelly at the café, of course!

Both of my hands are tugged insistently. 
It feels just like children seeking 
affection from a parent.
choice_data_list: I-I'll definitely go to both, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're quite popular, aren't you? 
Well then? Where shall we begin?
choice_data_list: Have fun at the toy store!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohhh!? Carrotman's got a new weapon 
out!? I'm so glad I came!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! What a cute hand mirror! I didn't 
know they sold things like this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph! You two are such babies! Making a 
scene in a toy store, honestly...! ......

As she said that, Sweep Tosho fixed her 
gaze intently on a single spot.

Toy "magical girl wands" were lined up 
there.

I need someone to distract Sweep Tosho. I 
gave Super Creek a subtle glance, and she 
nodded gently.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "Do you want that wand, Sweep-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...!? I-I d-don't want that! It's so 
childish...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That baton is cute, but it also has a cool 
vibe to it. It makes me want one too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You too, Creek...!? It's the same 
for you, Creek!?
choice_data_list: I bought wands for you both!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
……W-Well, if you already bought it, then I 
suppose it can't be helped. I-I don't 
really want it, but…… I'll take it off 
your hands.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Sweep-chan, that's not fair~! Maya 
wants a pretty, grown-up hand mirror like 
that too~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! Carrot Man's new weapon is just 
way too cool to resist!"

...It ended up being an unexpected 
expense, but somehow, I didn't feel bad 
about it at all.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much for today.
choice_data_list: I had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...So bitteh.

The adult coffee jelly Mayano Top Gun 
wanted to try turned out to be much more 
bitter than imagined.

The coffee jelly was so bitter that the 
three kids' moods plummeted completely!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this coffee jelly is truly 
delicious. I almost want to eat everyone 
else's portion too♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, though, there won't be 
enough dessert for everyone."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"It can't be helped. What new dessert 
would everyone like to eat?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: This is a thank-you for the coffee jelly♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I-I did it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I-I suppose it can't be helped! I'll let 
you have the coffee jelly!

And so, peace was preserved for the 
children's taste buds.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you very much for today.
choice_data_list: I had a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, today was a truly wonderful day.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's so lively today... It really feels 
like we came out to play as a family.

Three little ones who are energetic and a 
handful. And if that's the case, then 
Super Creek and I are...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Creek-senpai! Trainer! What are you doing? 
I'm gonna leave you behind!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, ufufu, let us hurry. The children are 
waiting♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hey, Dad♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hey, Mom♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm only joking♪
